BindSecurityTemplateToEntity.document:
This method unbinds a specified domain name that has been bound to a policy template from the policy template. Currently, it only supports unbinding one domain name at a time. When unbinding, the following options are supported:
1. If the rule quota allows, the current policy is retained. When unbinding, a standalone security policy is generated for the domain name. This policy uses the same configuration as the current policy Template, and the rules in it will use additional rule quota.
2. Use a blank security policy. Use the default blank policy. Preset rules will use the default configuration, and custom rule content will no longer take effect.

Example: To unbind a.test.com from an existing policy template (policy template ID: temp-cuwg1hki, associated site ID: zone-2aq0e8rhu6jx), see the following example to proceed with unbinding.

Note: If you choose to retain the current policy configuration, please ensure the current site has sufficient security rule quota. If the remaining quota is insufficient to support retaining the current policy, unbinding will fail and the domain will remain bound to the current policy template.
BindSecurityTemplateToEntity.input:
POST / HTTP/1.1
Host: teo.tencentcloudapi.com
Content-Type: application/json
X-TC-Action: OperateSecurityTemplate
<Common request parameters>

{
    "ZoneId": "zone-2aq0e8rhu6jx",
    "Entities": [
        "a.test.com"
    ],
    "TemplateId": "temp-cuwg1hki",
    "Operate": "unbind-keep-policy"
}
BindSecurityTemplateToEntity.title: Unbind a specified domain name from a policy template
